title: Complete the harness and package it as a Claude Code plugin
specification: Implement the five design milestones (intake, verification, hooks, review and orchestration, distribution) as a zero-dependency Node plugin under plugins/harness, aligned with the family contract and the codex-harness harness.json v3 and task formats, using native Claude Code hooks, skills, subagents and worktree isolation.
acceptance_criteria: node --test passes, including every case in contract/guard-cases.json run against the plugin guard.
claude plugin validate --strict passes for the marketplace and the plugin.
scripts/demo.sh shows, on a disposable project with a real Docker Compose stack, a guard denial, a failing gate, and a passing gate after repair, and leaves no containers behind.
The plugin loads in a fresh Claude Code session and its skills, agents and hooks are listed.
